name: ChoAppealTaskStatusVS
title: CHO Appeal Task Status Value Set
description: The subset of HL7 Task.status codes used by CHO appeal workflow. Strict subset of http://hl7.org/fhir/task-status; narrowing a base required binding to a strict subset is permitted by FHIR R4 conformance rules. Codes enumerated explicitly (not filter-based) so readers and offline validators do not require a live terminology server. Authored by Cloud Health Office under its own canonical namespace; does not claim conformance to any external Implementation Guide.
